name: s0_tokenizers
caption: Round-trip integrity (decode(encode(x)) == x) for every generator tokenizer across ASCII, Unicode, whitespace and long-repetition probes, plus exactness of the tail operation the sliding window relies on. A failure invalidates W for that model.
alt_text: Round-trip integrity (decode(encode(x)) == x) for every generator tokenizer across ASCII, Unicode, whitespace and long-repetition probes, plus exactness of the tail operation the sliding window relies on. A failure invalidates W for that model.
limitations: Short-probe round-trip (ASCII, Unicode, whitespace, long-repetition) does not certify in-trajectory W arithmetic at 4096 tokens. A failure here invalidates W; a pass does not replace per-step tokenizer_roundtrip_ok on the generation run.
